narrative:

You ranked in the very bottom decile, the first decile, while accepted students typically sit around the sixth decile. This signaled to the model that academic struggles may persist in a rigorous law school environment, pushing the prediction strongly toward bar exam failure. Your first-year class standing contributed similarly, though with slightly less weight. Being in the bottom decile again, compared to an average of about sixth decile among accepted applicants, reinforced the same concern about your academic trajectory.

However, this single point of strength was not powerful enough to overcome the two strong signals from your low class standings.

Retaking the LSAT could also help, since you are already close to the average. Address the academic weaknesses head-on, and reapply when your record better reflects your potential.
